BiblicalUsage: Dodavah was the father of Eliezer, the prophet who told Jehoshaphat that the Lord had broken his ships because he joined himself with Ahaziah. His name is tied to that one warning.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a father's name is remembered because his son spoke the truth to a king, and the warning about an unholy alliance still stands.
